Setting to adjust foliage quality and densitiy.

Low values can cause overly passive bots who just sit and wait,. High values can cause swarming in some situations.

Toggle to show a dedicated notify when your weapon malfunctions or not. 

If turned off, you need to rely on the audio cue.

How much radio effect should be applied to player voices.

Setting to toggle nameplates on your team mates.
When bots are further than this distance to a human player, Their movement will be completely disabled  to  improve their performance cost on your CPU.
Controls how much AI will affect your CPU performance when in raid. Provides a tradeoff of visual quality/smoothness of bots at a distance for CPU overhead.
Bots further than this distance, In Meters, will be fully disabled and invisible.

Resets the character to the starting position.
A value of 0 disables this timer.
How long after perceiving the player the AI will deliberate miss the target.

When bots are further than this distance to a human player, Their tick-rate and movement will be heavily reduced to  improve their performance cost on your CPU, and their movement physics will be at their most simple.
When a bot finishes searching, do they forget about the enemy or do they continue searching until their memory length timer expires?
Define the volume of other players using in game voice chat.
The maximum distance, in meters, that bots are able to see enemy targets.
Controls the randomized spread bots have when shooting.
If a bot is shooting at someone further than this distance, in Meters, they will swap to using semi auto. Otherwise they will swap to full auto if available.
All senses on a bot have an enforced delay before they can actually perceive it. This is the base time for that delay.
Select an AI difficult preset or make a custom one.
How far bots will automatically communicate to other AI when they perceive an enemy. In Meters
Enable or disable AI suppressing the last known location of their enemy. If disabled, bots will only shoot when their enemy is visible.

When bots are further than this distance to a human player, Their tick-rate and movement will be moderately reduced to  improve their performance cost on your CPU, and their movement physics will be simplified.

Enabling can cause bots to be much sneakier.
Disabling can give you information on how many enemies you are fighting. So if they are talking, you know there is a group of them.
Define how much player voices are influenced by distance to yourself.
Extra Sense Delay on First Contact
How long after a bot searches your last known location will they return back to a peaceful state and de-aggro.
Setting to toggle the compass at the top for orientation.
Increase or decrease how long bots wait in between firing single shots or firing bursts. Linear Multiplier, so a value of 2.0 will double the time they wait.
When enabled, bots will check to see if a friendly unit is within their perception sharing radius before speaking. If not, they will not say any voicelines.
Setting to adjust visual effects like particles.
When bots are further than this distance to a human player, their tick-rate and movement will be slightly reduced to  improve their performance cost on your CPU.
Controls how much AI will affect your CPU performance when in raid. Provides a tradeoff of visual quality/smoothness of bots at a distance for CPU overhead.
Setting to toggle if the character should automatically go into low ready after being in idle for more than 10 seconds.
This enabled NVIDIAs newest technology Ray Reconstruction. It greatly improves image quality by reducing noise and artifacts as well as providing a clearer image.
Define how much player voices are influenced by occlusion of in game objects between them and the player.
Setting to have your health/stamina bar always visible, only if it has changed recently or entirely disable it.
Turns voice chat ON/OFF.<Strong>On</>: You can hear your teammates and can also talk to them by using a microphone.<Strong>OFF</>: You cannot hear or talk to your teammates.
When a bot goes from being at peace/on patrol to in combat, they receive this as an additional delay ontop of the base sense delay.
Select CPU Simulation Level for AI.
Setting to set overall quality level.
Setting to adjust visual fidelity. Changes maximal pixels per mesh for nanite. Lower settings can lead to pixelated foliage.
You can change the keybinding in the corresponding tab.
Wether you always want steady mic input or only when you press the Push-To-Talk button.

If a bot is shooting at someone further than this distance, in Meters, they will swap to using semi auto. Otherwise they will swap to full auto if available.
A multiplier that works on top of the base AI count on the map and the default AI coop multiplier.
Manually set the ranges used to optimize AI that are far from any human player.
Increase or decrease how long bots wait before they can fire their first shots when aiming.. Linear Multiplier, so a value of 2.0 will double the time they wait.

How long after a bot searches your last known location will they return back to a peaceful state and de-aggro.
Perception Gain Threshold at 1 for example means that if the AI has perfect view on the player it takes 1 second until they "actual" see the player and turn to them.
Setting to adjust Post Processing quality.  Enables volumetric effects like volmetric fog and clouds on High and Epic.
While in-game, this is affected by many different factors, such as whether a bot is already aware of you, whether they are suppressed, ect.

The maximum distance, in meters, that bots are able to see enemy targets.
Be careful, as more enemies could lead to worse performance. Values over 2.0 are not recommended for normal gameplay.
Higher = More smooth, higher ticks per second.
